Maya: Quick sync — QuantumBurst dedicated cutover set for Thu 04:00 PT. Committed 58k tokens/min. Need quota verify, autoscale tuning, 20m shadow, and a short enablement. Who can own?

Ibrahim: I'll validate quota and confirm egress with their infra. Last time ISP caps hit us around 32k.

Cory: I'll own autoscale. Proposal: min_nodes=4, step=+2, scale_up if cpu>64% or queue>220, cooldown 45s. During golden hour set scale-in cooldown=5m.

Lynn: I'll run shadow load (mixed prompts). Running `wrk` with orbis.lua variant, will report P50/P95 and 5xx.

AutoscaleBot: [09:12] policy-sim: 'burst-conservative' -> meets 58k in ~11m, median scale latency 40s.

Maya: SLA targets: P95 short <120ms, P95 long <320ms, error budget 0.25%. Also capture renewal risk: CSM flagged month-1 cost concern. CSM-Jen to own forecast.

Lynn: Shadow1 results: sustained 53.2k tokens/min, P95 short=118ms, P95 long=380ms (long is high), 5xx=0.03%. Autoscale added nodes as expected. Logs: https://logs.internal/qb/5255550000/shadow1

Cory: Try enabling `kv_prefetch` for long-paths and reduce batch_max_tokens to 3072 for those requests. Also enable tracing for first 48h.

Ibrahim: QuantumBurst infra replied — opened ticket to raise egress to 70Gbps, ETA 30h. Sharing test endpoints. If not green by EOD, we should delay cutover 48h.

Lynn: Shadow2 with kv_prefetch running now. Will post concise numbers.

CSM-Jen: I'll prepare 90-day cost forecast template and schedule a renewal touchpoint at week 6. Also will run a 30m enablement Wed 10:00 PT and capture NPS + 3 example prompts for regressions.

AutoscaleBot: [09:55] canary-create: 4% route created for model 'redwood-quantumburst'. Monitors active: latency, errors, cpu, queue-depth, autoscale events.

Maya: Owners: Ibrahim=quota & infra, Cory=autoscale & runbook, Lynn=shadow tests & logs, Jen=CSM + renewal. Reconvene tomorrow 09:00 PT for final greenlight. :thumbsup:
